title: Midnight bridge handoff journal
content:
Quick context: took the 23:00-03:00 bridge. Goal: capture the weird state changes and temporary steps I left so day crew (Samir) can pick up cleanly. This is personal, rough — copy into official runbook if anything becomes repeatable.

Summary of shifts and incidents:
- 00:12: Redis read replicas showing elevated replication lag (~18s) after backup job; cause likely IO contention on /data2. Restarted backup job (systemd) at 00:28 to stagger windows; lag returned to ~2s.
- 01:05: Hosted-API p99 latency spike (1.2s -> 2.4s) for ~8mins. Root cause: a model variant (gptx-small-qa) autoscaled up and exhausted GPU mem on node-> triggered swap pressure. Temporarily scaled down batching (route config) to reduce concurrent tokens.
- 02:30: Alert: dedicated-queue-6 dropped connections to worker pool (tcp RST flood). Found a buggy health-check script on node gpu-12 causing connection storm. Disabled health-check systemd unit (temporary) and filed ONCALL-412.

Immediate actions taken (commands and notes):
- Disabled nightly backup on infra-backup-2 until investigation: sudo systemctl stop infra-backup-2 && sudo systemctl mask infra-backup-2
- Changed route batching config for hosted-qa to target max_concurrency=8 (was 16) via: curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/routes/hosted-qa/config -d '{\"max_concurrency\":8}' (note: API token env var: $ADMIN_TOKEN_NIGHT)
- Drained gpu-12 from serving pool: ./bin/nodectl cordon gpu-12 && ./bin/nodectl drain gpu-12 --timeout 300s
- Disabled misbehaving health-check: sudo systemctl stop node-health-check && sudo systemctl disable node-health-check

Open items for next shift / follow-ups:
- Investigate backup job IO pattern and whether it should prefer low-IO windows or use throttling. Link: ONCALL-412. Owner: infra team (Priya). Priority: P2.
- Validate that model variant autoscaling policy has an eviction threshold to avoid mem-exhaustion. Owner: serving-runtime. Ticket: SRT-224.
- Re-enable health-check only after we confirm fixes on node-health-check script (it was making ~300 connections/min). DO NOT re-enable on gpu-12 until patched.
- Check SLO dashboard for hosted-qa across the 00:00–02:00 window; alert was noisy, maybe tune alerting.

Temporary procedures (write into runbook if validated):
1) If Redis replica lag > 10s for > 10min: check backup jobs, check disk IO on /data2, and consider staggering backups. Quick commands: iostat -x 5 3; sudo lsof +D /data2 | wc -l
2) For p99 latency spikes correlated to autoscaling events: reduce route max_concurrency by 2x for the route and notify serving-runtime; collect heap/gpu memory dumps from nodes involved.
3) For TCP connection floods from health-checks: cordon+drain node, disable unit, gather systemd journal: journalctl -u node-health-check -S '1 hour ago' > /tmp/healthcheck.log

Notes to successor (Samir):
- Credentials: I left a short-lived admin token in 1Password item 'night-admin-token' (expires in 48h). Use only for config changes and rotate if you use it.
- If you re-enable infra-backup-2, add --io-throttle or schedule at 03:30 instead of 00:00.
- Look at gpu-12 kernel logs: dmesg | grep -i oom; I saw some oom_killer traces around 00:58.

Quick checklist at handover (please sign off in Slack thread):
- [ ] Verify gpu-12 remains cordoned and no new tasks scheduled
- [ ] Confirm backup job is masked and infra team assigned
- [ ] Check SLO dashboard and decide if alert threshold needs tuning
- [ ] File any new tickets for follow-ups, link here

Unresolved questions / TODOs to log:
- Why did backup job IO spike only on infra-backup-2 not infra-backup-1? Disk SMART looks okay; maybe different storage class.
- Is there any correlation between model variant rollout last night and the mem pressure? Check deployment timeline: GH PR #7823 (serving-runtime).

Random notes / shorthand I scribbled: 
- 00:09 asked @priya on Slack to confirm infra-backup-2 schedule -> ack at 00:22
- 01:12 collected heap stacks from node gpu-11 and gpu-12; stored at /tmp/heap-gpu11-20260310.gz (temp)
- Left a sticky: "do not unmask backup until triage" pinned to infra ticket ONCALL-412

If anything critical pops while you're taking over, ping me directly (Elena) — I'm awake until ~04:00 and will check slack. Otherwise, please paste the important findings into Confluence under /display/SRE/Nightly+Handoffs when you have a chance.

End of handoff.
